newsitem.title: USA: Piedmont cuts natgas rates 16 pct in S.C..
newsitem.headline: Piedmont cuts natgas rates 16 pct in S.C..

text.p: Piedmont Natural Gas Co said Thursday it would cut the price of natural gas to all 97,000 of its residential customers in South Carolina by 16.04 percent, effective March 1.

The rate reduction stems from lower wholesale prices for natural gas. The company cited reduced demand due to high gas storage levels on the East Coast and milder weather nationwide over the past several months.
For the average customer, the decrease will mean a reduction in the April bill of $15.10, to $82.54, from $97.64.
